content_of_post_to_comment: It’s an arguably banal yet underrated development that Google AI-enhanced search does this very amusing and jarring thing where it just reifies any semi-gibberish string of words into a supposedly existing concept (linked sources including YouTube don’t actually describe this. Not a bad idea though)
comment: The strange part is that this isn't just hallucination, but a kind of semantic overfitting: search systems may be optimized to find patterns where humans would first ask whether the premise exists.
